name: README.md
content:
# Truth - Fluent assertions for Java and Android

Truth makes your test assertions and failure messages more readable.

## Getting Started

```java
import static com.google.common.truth.Truth.assertThat;

assertThat(someString).isEqualTo("expected");
assertThat(someList).contains("item");
```

## Features

- Fluent API for clear assertions
- Rich failure messages
- Extensive matcher library
